panels.title: Ingest freshness (minutes since the newest ingested hour ended)
panels.description: GH Archive publishes an hour a few minutes after it ends; above ~90 means ingest is stuck.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dateDiff('minute', max(hour_start) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR, now()) AS minutes
FROM ghflow.ops_ingest_audit WHERE outcome = 'accepted'

panels.title: Reconciliation: hours by status (latest run)
panels.description: Batch = stream = ClickHouse per hour. Anything but green names its ids in reconcile_results.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status, count() AS hours FROM (
  SELECT hour, argMax(status, checked_at) AS status FROM ghflow.ops_reconcile_results
  WHERE checked_at > now() - INTERVAL 3 HOUR GROUP BY hour
) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

panels.title: Flagged hours per day (quality)
panels.description: flagged: volume or PushEvent broke (shaded on the stakeholder dashboard); shifted: minor types moved.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(hour_start) AS time, countIf(status = 'flagged') AS flagged,
  countIf(status = 'shifted') AS shifted FROM (
  SELECT hour, any(hour_start) AS hour_start, argMax(status, judged_at) AS status
  FROM ghflow.ops_quality_verdicts GROUP BY hour
) WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Events per hour (ClickHouse)
panels.description: Distinct events per hour, as the third witness holds them.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT hour_start AS time, groupBitmapMerge(ids) AS events FROM ghflow.events_hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Consumer lag · lander
panels.description: Messages lander has not yet committed on gharchive.events, summed over partitions. Flat is healthy; a steady climb means the consumer stopped.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, sum(lag) AS lag FROM ghflow.consumer_lag
WHERE `group` = 'lander' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

  SELECT hour, any(hour_start) AS hour_start, argMax(status, judged_at) AS status
  FROM ghflow.ops_quality_verdicts GROUP BY hour
) WHERE status = 'flagged' ORDER BY hour_start DESC LIMIT 200
